metaDescription: Every Indian bank account, balance and transaction on one screen. Upload a statement; Horizon sorts spending, tracks bills and goals. 7 days free.
heroEyebrow: Statements from HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Axis and more
heroBody: Every bank account, balance and transaction on one calm screen. Upload a statement or connect a bank; Horizon sorts the spending, spots the bills and keeps your savings goals in view.
trust: Statements are read once and never stored. Horizon never asks for your net-banking password.
cap1Body: Upload a PDF, Excel or CSV statement from any bank, or connect one. Every balance sits together, each in its own currency.
cap2Body: UPI, cards, EMIs and pay-later settlements are grouped on their own. Correct a label once and Horizon remembers it.
cap3Title: Bills and goals that stay on track
cap3Body: Subscriptions and recurring bills are found in your statements, with what is due next. Savings goals show how far along you are.
f1Body: Your total across banks, where the money sits, and this month's spending by type, with your bank cards beside them. One glance, nothing to configure.
f2Title: Upload a statement, get it sorted
f2Body: Drop a statement from your net banking, password and all. Horizon checks it with you before saving, then sorts every entry: EMIs, pay-later, groceries, subscriptions, transfers.
f3Body: Netflix, Crunchyroll, YouTube, Airtel, the electricity bill: Horizon spots what recurs in your statements and lines up what is due next, so nothing surprises you.
f4Body: An emergency fund, a trip, a down payment. Set a target and a monthly amount, and watch each one fill up as your balances grow.
priceTitle: {days} days free, then {monthly} a month or {yearly} a year.
priceBody: No card to start. Cancel any time; access lasts to the end of the paid period. Seeing, downloading and deleting your data is always free.
closingBody: Take back the overview that a dozen bank apps keep from you.
shotHome: Horizon's home page: the total across banks, a doughnut of where the money sits, spending by type and the bank cards
shotHistory: Horizon's account history: entries sorted into categories, with inflow, outflow and net for the month
shotBills: Horizon's bills page: subscriptions and recurring bills found in the statements, with what is due next
shotGoals: Horizon's savings goals, each with a target and progress
shotConnect: Horizon's connect-a-bank page: upload a statement, then check it before saving
shotHero: The top of Horizon's landing page: the name over three screens of the app
shotPhone: Horizon's home page on a phone
